title: Yamal nets in Spain’s 3-2 comeback win against England in Nations League
english: Spain defeated England 3-2 in a Nations League match, maintaining their remarkable 39-game unbeaten streak. Although England took a lead following Lamine Yamal's opening goal and a missed penalty by Harry Kane, Spain capitalized on defensive errors to secure the comeback victory. This result marks another loss for England against the reigning world champions.
amharic: ስፔን በእንግሊዝ ላይ 3 ለ 2 በሆነ ውጤት በማሸነፍ የ39 ጨዋታዎች ያለመሸነፍ ክብረ ወሰኗን አስቀጥላለች። ላሚን ያማል መሪውን ግብ ቢያስቆጥርም እንግሊዝ መሪነቱን ወስዳ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሃሪ ኬን የፍጹም ቅጣት ምት በመሳቱ እና የእንግሊዝ የተከላካይ ክፍል ባሳየው ስህተት ስፔን ወደ ጨዋታው በመመለስ አሸንፋለች። ይህ ውጤት የዓለም ሻምፒዮኗን ስፔን ብርታት ያሳየበት ሆኗል።
oromo: Ispeeniin tapha Nations League irratti Ingilizii 3-2 kan injifatte yoo ta'u, rekardii tapha 39 osoo hin injifatamin itti fufuun ishee mirkaneessiteetti. Lamine Yamal goolii jalqabaa erga galchee booda Ingiliiziin dursuu dandeesse turte, ta'us Harry Kane penaaltii waan badeef fi dogoggora ittisaa Ingiliiz irraa uumame fayyadamuun Ispeeniin injifannoo ishee gonfatteetti. Injifannoon kun gadi jabeessitee injifatattuu addunyaa ta'uu Ispeeniin kan agarsiise dha.

title: Russia scales up strikes on Ukraine as largest steelmaker halts operations
english: Russian forces have launched an intensified series of attacks across multiple regions of Ukraine. In response to the growing danger, ArcelorMittal has shut down its massive steel plant in Kryvyi Rih. The company cited safety concerns for its workers as the reason for suspending all facility operations.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዩክሬን የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ጥቃታቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ አርሴሎር ሚታል የተባለው ትልቅ የብረታ ብረት ፋብሪካ በክሪቪ ሪህ የሚገኘውን ቅርንጫፉን በጊዜያዊነት ዘግቷል። ኩባንያው ስራውን ያቆመው ለሰራተኞቹ ደህንነት ሲባል ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa naannolee Yuukreen garaa garaa irratti haleellaa cimaa gaggeessaa jiru. Dhaabbatichi hojii isaa kan dhaabe ogeeyyiin isaa miidhaa irraa akka oolaniif yaadamee ti.

title: Why is violence between Pakistan and Afghanistan recurring?
english: Tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan have escalated, leading to recent military strikes following a breakdown in their relationship. Although Islamabad initially supported the Taliban's 2021 return to power, relations have soured over accusations that Kabul is protecting militant groups launching attacks inside Pakistan. Afghanistan denies these claims, and ongoing efforts to resolve the cycle of violence between the two neighbors have not yet succeeded.

title: Hamas slams Board of Peace for refusal to work with UNRWA in Gaza
english: Hamas has criticized the Board of Peace for refusing to collaborate with UNRWA in Gaza, labeling the decision as a biased move that mirrors Israeli policy. The Board of Peace claimed that UNRWA is not a reliable partner, though some officials privately suggested they have continued to interact with the agency. This controversy highlights the ongoing tension over UNRWA's future, as Palestinians rely on the agency for essential services and as a symbol of their right to return.
amharic: ሃማስ በጋዛ የሰላም ቦርድ ከዩኤንአርደብሊውኤ (UNRWA) ጋር ለመስራት ፈቃደኛ አለመሆኑን በማውገዝ፣ ይህ ውሳኔ ከእስራኤል አቋም ጋር የተጣጣመ ነው ሲል ከሷል። የሰላም ቦርዱ ድርጅቱ ታማኝ አይደለም በማለት የራሱን አቋም ቢገልጽም፣ በስተጀርባ ግን ከዩኤንአርደብሊውኤ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ አለመግባባት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች መብትና እርዳታን የሚደግፈው የዩኤንአርደብሊውኤ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ምን እንደሚሆን አከራካሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hamaas 'Board of Peace' jedhamu gargaarsa UNRWA (dhaabbata gargaarsa baqattoota Falasxiin) Gaza keessatti akka hin fayyadamne murteessuu isaa balaaleffateera. Hamaas murtoon kun Israa'el gargaarsa Falasxiin akka dhaabdu fi mirga deebii baqattootaa akka ukkaamsituuf gargaaruu dha jedheera. Board of Peace-n UNRWA irratti amanannaa akka hin qabne ibsus, garuu iccitidhaan dhaabbaticha waliin hojjechaa akka turan gabaasni ni mul'isa. Falasxiinonni dhaabbatichi dhimma ijoo jireenyaa fi mirga isaanii waan ta'eef, dhiibbaan irratti godhamu kun rakkoo cimaa akka uume dubbatu.

title: Iran says awaiting response through mediators after Trump reaction to proposal
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Tehran is currently waiting for a formal response from the United States regarding a recent proposal. While they have noted an initial reaction from President Donald Trump, they are expecting mediators to deliver a definitive official stance. Iran intends to evaluate this forthcoming information before deciding on its next steps.

oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchii akka jedhanitti, Iraan dhiyeessa ishee irratti deebii mootummaa Ameerikaa irraa eeggachaa jirti. Prezidaant Doolald Tiraamp irraa yaada jalqabaa dhagahus, hanga ammaatti karaa giddu-galeessotaa deebii murtaa'aa ta'e hin arganne. Iraan tarkaanfii itti aanu fudhachuuf deebii dhumaa giddu-galeessota irraa dhufu kana akka eeggattu ibsameera.

title: Iran warns of restrictions on ships using unauthorised Hormuz routes
english: Iranian authorities have announced that vessels navigating the Strait of Hormuz will face strict penalties if they deviate from approved shipping lanes. This declaration follows US President Donald Trump’s refusal of an offer from Iran to normalize relations and reopen the waterway. Consequently, tensions remain high regarding the movement of ships through this critical maritime passage.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በሆርሙዝ ባህር ላይ በተፈቀዱ የጉዞ መስመሮች ውጪ የሚንቀሳቀሱ መርከቦች ከባድ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኢራን ግንኙነትን ለማደስ እና የባህር መተላለፊያውን ለመክፈት ያቀረበችውን ጥያቄ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት በወሳኙ የባህር መስመር ላይ ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hoji-geeyyonni Iran akka ibsanitti, markeewwan daandii seeraan hayyamame ala Hormuz keessatti socho'an irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan kan fudhatamu ta'a. Ibsi kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaantiin Amerikaa Doonald Tiraamp dhiyeessa Iran kan hariiroo fooyyeessuu fi daandii galaana sana banuuf dhiyaate didanii boodadha. Kanaafuu, sochiin markeewwan daandii barbaachisaa ta'e kana keessatti taasifamu ammas yaaddoo keessa jira.

title: Pezeshkian says US and Israel are trying to pit countries against each other
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has urged Muslim nations to unite and avoid internal conflicts. He claimed that the United States and Israel are intentionally creating divisions among countries in the region. Upon returning from the UN General Assembly, he criticized these nations for ignoring international law and committing injustices against the Iranian people.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት መስኡድ پزشکیያን የእስልምና ሀገራት ተባብረው በውስጣዊ ግጭት ከመጠመድ እንዲቆጠቡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል በክልሉ ያሉ ሀገራትን እርስ በእርስ በማጋጨት ለመከፋፈል እንደሚሰሩ ተናግረዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤን አጠናቀው ወደ ሀገራቸው እንደተመለሱም፣ እነዚህ ሀገራት አለም አቀፍ ህግን በመጣስ በኢራን ህዝብ ላይ በደል እየፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masoud Pezeshkian biyyooti Islaamaa tokkummaa uumanii walitti bu'iinsa keessoo irraa akka of qusatan dhaamaniiru. Ameerikaa fi Israa'el naannichatti biyyoota gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumuuf karoorfatanii akka hojjechaa jiran himaniiru. Gabaasa Walga'ii Waliigalaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii booda gara biyyattii yeroo deebi'an, biyyooti kunneen seera idil-addunyaa cabsuudhaan ummata Iraan irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaanii balleesaniiru.

title: Oman calls for "restraint" and dialogue in the Middle East conflict
english: Oman's Foreign Minister has urged all sides involved in Middle East tensions to practice restraint and pursue peaceful dialogue to reach lasting political solutions. Speaking at the United Nations, he also expressed his nation's ongoing dedication to ensuring safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. This statement follows the rejection of an Iranian truce proposal by U.S. leadership.
amharic: የኦማን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለተፈጠረው ግጭት ሁሉም ወገኖች መረጋጋትን እንዲመርጡና በውይይት ዘላቂ መፍትሄ እንዲያመጡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር ጉዞ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ጥሪ የተሰማው የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኢራን ያቀረበችውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ውድቅ ካደረገች በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Omaan walitti bu'iinsa Baha Giddu galeessaa keessatti hirmaatan hundi of qabuun mariin rakkoo isaanii akka hiikan waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Ejjennoo isaanii kan ibsan dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti yoo ta'u, Omaan karaa galaana Ormuz nagaya eeguuf kutannoo qabdu irra deebi'anii mirkaneessaniiru. Waamichi kun kan dhufe erga mootummaan Ameerikaa yaada waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa kan Iraan dhiyeessite diddee boodadha.

title: Hamas leader says Israel to use Gaza 'blood' in election
english: A senior Hamas official has dismissed the impact of Israel's upcoming elections, arguing that all Israeli political factions are equally responsible for Palestinian suffering. He expressed strong opposition to Palestinian lives being used as a political tool for campaign rhetoric. Ultimately, he emphasized that the group remains focused on achieving Palestinian rights rather than political shifts within Israel.
amharic: የሀማስ ከፍተኛ አመራር የእስራኤልን መጪ ምርጫ የፍልስጤማውያንን ችግር ለመፍታት ምንም ለውጥ አያመጣም ሲሉ አጣጥለውታል። የፍልስጤም ህዝብ ስቃይ ለምርጫ ቅስቀሳ እንደ መሳርያ እንዲውል እንደማይፈቅዱም ገልጸዋል። ከዚህ ይልቅ ትኩረታቸው የፍልስጤም ህዝብ መብቶችን እና ግቦችን ማስጠበቅ ላይ ብቻ እንደሆነ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Hamaas akka jedhutti, filannoon Israa'el dhufu furmaata rakkoo ummata Filisxeemii fiduu hin danda'u. Hojiin siyaasaa Israa'el hundi rakkoo ummata isaanii kan hammeessan malee jijjiirama kan hin fidne ta'uu ibseera. Kanaafuu, dhiigni ummata Filisxeemii injifannoo siyaasaa argachuuf kan itti fayyadaman ta'uu akka hin qabne dubbateera.

title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
english: The German town of Heidenau has sparked significant controversy by voting to ban 'stumbling stone' memorials, which are brass plaques placed on streets to honor Nazi victims. Local councillors argued these memorials should be moved to a cemetery to prevent people from walking on them. However, critics and political figures have condemned the decision, describing it as an attempt to make the memory of victims invisible and a failure to properly acknowledge history.
amharic: የጀርመኗ ሀይደናው ከተማ በናዚ ሰለባዎች መታሰቢያነት በመንገድ ላይ የሚቀመጡ የናስ ንጣፎችን መከልከሏ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። የከተማው አስተዳደር እነዚህን መታሰቢያዎች ሰዎች እንዳይረግጧቸው ወደ መቃብር ቦታ ማዛወር እንዳለባቸው ቢገልጽም፣ ውሳኔው ታሪክን የሚሽር እና የሰለባዎችን መታሰቢያ ከሕዝብ እይታ የሚያርቅ ነው በሚል ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። ታዋቂ ሰዎችና የፖለቲካ ተንታኞችም ይህ አካሄድ የናዚ ሰለባዎችን መታሰቢያ በሕዝብ ቦታዎች ላይ የመጠበቅን አስፈላጊነት ችላ ያለ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan Heidenau jedhamtuu kan Jarmanii, yaadannoo namoota Naaziin ajjeefamanif ganda keessatti kaayyaman kanneen 'stumbling stone' jedhaman dhorkuun ishee mormii guddaa kaaseera. Abbootiin taayitaa magaalaa kun yaadannoo kana namoonni irra hin ejjetneef gara iddoo awwaalchaatti jijjiiruu akka qaban dubbataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, qeeqtonniifi namoonni beekamoon murtii kana akka yaadatama dhugaa namoota miidhamanii dhoksuufi seenaa dagachuu akka ta'etti ibsanii jiru.

title: Saudi FM accuses Iran of ‘flagrant attacks’ and condemns Houthis at UNGA
english: During his speech at the UN General Assembly, the Saudi Arabian Foreign Minister criticized Iran for conducting direct attacks against civilian and economic sites in the Middle East. He also urged the global community to take a firm stance against the Houthi rebels due to their ongoing threats to international shipping in the Red Sea. Saudi Arabia emphasized the need for collective action to ensure regional stability and security.
amharic: የሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ባደረጉት ንግግር ኢራን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በሚገኙ የሲቪል እና የኢኮኖሚ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት እያደረሰች ነው በማለት ከሰዋል። በተጨማሪም የሁቲ አማጽያን በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ስጋት በመቃወም ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የክልሉን ሰላምና ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ የጋራ ጥረት እንደሚያስፈልግ አጽንኦት ሰጥታለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Sa'udii Arabaa walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaarratti yoo dubbatan, Iraan naannichatti iddoowwan hawaasaa fi dinagdee irratti haleellaa raawwachaa jirti jechuun himatan. Gama biraan, gareen Huutii galaana diimaa keessatti markaboota daldalaa irratti sodaachisa raawwachaa jiru irratti hawaasni addunyaa tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Sa'udiin nageenya naannichaa mirkaneessuuf walta'iinsi addunyaa murteessaa ta'uu isaa ibsiteetti.

title: Ireland decide to play Israel in Nations League after squad vote
english: The Irish national football team has voted to proceed with their upcoming Nations League match against Israel. This decision followed discussions after one player considered withdrawing from the game. To address the humanitarian situation, the team plans to wear black armbands as a mark of respect for those who have died in the conflict.

oromo: Garee kubbaa miillaa biyyoolessa Ayirland tapha 'Nations League' kan dhufu irratti Isiraa'el wajjin taphachuuf sagalee kennuun murteessaniiru. Murteen kun kan darbe, taphataan tokko tapha kana irraa of baasuuf yaada qabaachuu isaa hordofee marii godhame booda dha. Gareen kun haleellaa fi waraana Gaza keessatti lubbuun darbeef kabaja agarsiisuuf, tapha irratti harka isaanii irratti marsaa gurraacha hidhachuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Lavrov: Russia’s war in Ukraine will continue ‘through to the end’
english: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov declared at the United Nations General Assembly that Russia will persist with its military campaign in Ukraine until all its goals are met. He described the ongoing invasion as a pursuit of truth and justice. This statement confirms that Moscow intends to continue the war until a final resolution is achieved on its own terms.
amharic: የሩሲያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሰርጌይ ላቭሮቭ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንደተናገሩት ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የጀመረችውን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ግቦቿ እስኪሳኩ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል ገልጸዋል። ይህንን ጦርነት ለእውነትና ለፍትህ የሚደረግ ትግል ሲሉ የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ ሞስኮ እስከ መጨረሻው ድረስ እንደሚገፋበት አረጋግጠዋል። በዚሁ መሰረት ሩሲያ ጦርነቱን ለማቆም ምንም አይነት ፍላጎት እንደሌላት ማሳያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Raashiyaa Sergeey Laavroov Walga'ii Waliigalaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniirratti akka ibsanitti, Raashiyaan waraana Yukreenii irratti banatte galmaan gahuuf hamma dhumaatti akka itti fuftu beeksisaniiru. Hojii waraanaa kana dhugaa fi haqaaf kan godhamu jechuun, Moskoon kaayyoo ishee guututti akka hin galmaanetti duubatti akka hin deebine ibsaniiru. Ibsi kunis mootummaan Raashiyaa waraana kana xumuraan milkeessuuf murteeffachuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Colombia extradites leader of armed group to US in shift towards Washington
english: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has extradited alleged drug trafficking leader Geovany Andres Rojas to the United States. This move marks a major policy shift, as the current administration abandons the previous government's negotiation-based approach in favor of military action and stronger cooperation with Washington. Rojas, who led a splinter group of former FARC rebels, will now face terrorism and drug trafficking charges in a California court.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው ፕሬዚዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ፣ አደንዛዥ ዕፅ አዘዋዋሪ ነው የተባለውን ጂዮቫኒ አንድሬስ ሮሃስን ወደ አሜሪካ አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የቀድሞው መንግስት በድርድር ይከተል የነበረውን ስልት በመተው፣ አሁን ያለው አስተዳደር በወታደራዊ እርምጃ እና ከአሜሪካ ጋር በቅርበት በመስራት ላይ ያተኮረ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ማድረጉን ያሳያል። የቀድሞ የፋርክ ታጣቂዎች ቡድን አባል የነበረው ሮሃስ፣ በአሜሪካ ፍርድ ቤት በሽብርተኝነት እና በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ወንጀል ክስ ይመሰረትበታል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kolombiyaa Abeelardoo de la Eespiriyeellaan, hogganaa garee seeraan alaa fi qabiinsa qoricha sammuu hadoochuu kessatti shakkame jiyoovanii Anndirees Roohaas gara Yunaayitid Isteetsitti erganiiru. Tarkaanfin kun jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, mootummaan ammaa karaa marii furmaata barbaaduu dhiisee, humna waraanaa fi hariiroo Yunaayitid Isteets waliin qabu cimsuu filateera. Roohaas, miseensa garee fkn (FARC) duraanii kan ture, amma gara biyyaatti eramee himannaa shororkeessummaa fi daldala qoricha sammuu hadoochuu irratti qabaata.

title: South African police discover body of 10th woman near Johannesburg
english: South African police have recovered the tenth female body found near Johannesburg since mid-July. Authorities are investigating these deaths amidst growing public alarm over the nation's extreme rates of violence against women. While officials are determining if the incidents are linked, high-level investigators have been assigned to the case to identify those responsible.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ ፖሊስ ከሐምሌ ወር አጋማሽ ጀምሮ በጆሃንስበርግ አካባቢ የተገኘ አስረኛውን የሴት አስከሬን አግኝቷል። በአገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሴቶች ላይ ጥቃት ተከትሎ ባለሥልጣናት ግድያዎቹ እርስ በርስ የተያያዙ መሆናቸውን እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ። መንግሥት ለጉዳዩ ቅድሚያ በመስጠት ወንጀለኞቹን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ ከፍተኛ መርማሪዎችን መድቧል።
oromo: Poolisiin Afrikaa Kibbaa baatii Waxabajjii irraa eegalee naannoo magaalaa Joohaanisbargitti reeffa dubartii kurnaffaa argateera. Haalli kun biyyattii keessatti miidhaa dubartoota irra gahuu fi sodaa uumame hordofee qorannoon cimaan irratti gaggeeffamaa jira. Qondaaltonni mootummaa ajjeechaan kunneen walitti hidhata qabaachuu fi dhabuu isaanii qulqulleessuuf qorattoota dandeettii qaban ramadanii hojjechaa jiru.

title: Gaza death toll rises
english: The Palestinian Ministry of Health reports that seven more people have died and 38 were injured in Gaza over the last two days. These figures add to the ongoing toll since the conflict began in October 2023, which has now reached over 74,000 deaths. Since the October 2025 ceasefire, authorities have documented more than 1,400 additional fatalities in the region.
amharic: የፍልስጤም የጤና ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት በጋዛ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 38 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ74,000 በላይ ደርሷል። በጥቅምት 2025 ከተደረገው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ብቻ ከ1,400 በላይ ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Falasxiin akka gabaasetti, guyyoota lamaan darban keessa Gaazaatti namoonni torba du'aniiru, 38 immoo madaa'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi Sadaasa 2023 eegale namoota 74,000 ol galaafateera. Onkololeessa 2025 waldhabbiin erga dhaabbate asitti, namoonni 1,400 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu isaanii qorannoon ni agarsiisa.

title: Iraq says US agrees to continue cash dollar shipments
english: The Iraqi government announced that it has reached an agreement with the United States to keep delivering physical cash dollars to the country. These shipments had faced interruptions earlier this year, but a new supply of cash is expected to arrive shortly. This development marks a return to regular cooperation following a period of suspended transfers that began in April.
amharic: የኢራቅ መንግስት ከአሜሪካ ጋር በመነጋገር የዶላር ጥሬ ገንዘብ ዝውውር እንዲቀጥል ስምምነት ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። ቀደም ሲል በነበረው የበርካታ ወራት እገዳ ምክንያት የገንዘብ አቅርቦቱ ተቋርጦ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በቀጣዮቹ ቀናት አዲስ የዶላር ጭነት እንደሚገባ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ስምምነት ካለፈው ሚያዝያ ወር ጀምሮ ተቋርጦ የነበረውን የገንዘብ ልውውጥ ሂደት ወደ ነበረበት ለመመለስ ታስቦ የተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraaq yeroo dhiyootti doolaara dhangala'aa Ameerikaarraa gara biyyatti erguu itti fufuuf walii galtee irra ga'uu isaa beeksiseera. Ergaa maallaqaa kana dura ji'oota hedduuf dhaabamee ture, garuu yeroo dhiyootti doolaarri haaraan biyyatti akka galu eegama. Walii galtuun kun ji'a Ebla darbe irraa jalqabee kan dhaabate ture yoo ta'u, amma deebi'ee itti fufuuf qophii ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: At UN, Saudi FM warns world failing to protect Gulf shipping
english: Saudi Arabia’s Foreign Minister recently urged the United Nations to take stronger action against the interference with shipping routes in the Middle East. He argued that Iranian-led disruptions in critical waterways like the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab al-Mandab Strait pose a significant danger to global energy supplies. The official called on the international community to fulfill its duty in ensuring safe and free navigation across these essential maritime passages.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባደረጉት ንግግር በአካባቢው የባህር መስመሮች ላይ እየተፈጠሩ ያሉ እንቅፋቶችን ዓለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰብ ሊያስቆም እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል። በሆርሙዝ እና በባብ አል-ማንዳብ የባህር ዳርቻዎች ላይ የሚፈጸሙት የኢራንና አጋሮቿ ድርጊቶች የዓለምን የኢነርጂ ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል ብለዋል። በመሆኑም ዓለም አቀፍ ማህበረሰብ የመርከቦችን ነጻ የጉዞ መብት ለማስጠበቅ እና ሰላምን ለማረጋገጥ የድርሻውን እንዲወጣ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Sa'udii Arabiyaa dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti akka ibsanitti, guutummaan addunyaa daandiiwwan galaanaa naannoo sanaa irratti giddu-galeessa ta'uun balaa jiru ittisuu qaba. Itti fayyadama daandiiwwan galaanaa barbaachisoo kanneen akka Hormuz fi Baab al-Mandab irratti gufuuwwan uumaman, nageenya anniisaa addunyaa irratti soda guddaa qaba. Kanaafuu, hawaasni idil-addunyaa bilisummaa daandiiwwan galaanaa eegsisuuf fi nageenya mirkaneessuuf itti gaafatamummaa isaa akka bahu gaafataniiru.

title: Qatar rejects Netanyahu’s claims over anti-Israel campaign
english: Qatar has officially dismissed accusations from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that it is orchestrating a campaign to manipulate youth against Israel. Qatari officials stated that this rhetoric is merely a distraction from Israel's actions in Palestinian territories and the resulting humanitarian crisis. Furthermore, Qatar argued that the global shift in public opinion is driven by people witnessing current events directly, rather than external influence.
amharic: ኳታር የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ወጣቶችን በእስራኤል ላይ ለማነሳሳት ዘመቻ እያካሄደች ነው በሚል ያቀረቡትን ክስ በይፋ ውድቅ አድርጋለች። የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው ይህ ንግግር በእስራኤል መንግስት በፓለስቲና ግዛቶች ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ትኩረት ለማዘናጋት የሚደረግ ሙከራ ነው። በተጨማሪም የአለም አቀፍ ህዝብ አመለካከት እየተቀየረ ያለው በውጫዊ ተጽዕኖ ሳይሆን፣ በዓይናቸው በሚያዩት ወቅታዊ ሁኔታዎች መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Qatar himannaa ministirri muummee Israa'el Binyamin Netanyaahu dargaggoota Israa'el irratti kakaasuuf duula geggeessaa jirti jedhanii dhiyeessan gadi jabeessuun mormiteetti. Qataar akka ibsitetti, himannaan kun gocha mootummaan Israa'el naannolee Paalastaayinii keessatti raawwataa jiruufi miidhaa namoomaa isaa irraa xiyyeeffannoo dhibuuf kan uumamedha. Kana malees, jijjiiramni ilaalchaa addunyaa dhiibbaa alaa miti, garuu namoonni gochawwan amma raawwatamaa jiran ofii isaanii arguun kan murtii kennan ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
english: An independent review of the 2025 shooting of activist Charlie Kirk at Utah Valley University found significant security failures in the event's planning. The report concluded that the university failed to conduct proper risk assessments and allowed the hosting organization, Turning Point USA, to override safety concerns regarding the outdoor venue. While investigators noted poor coordination between campus police and private security, they determined that no staff members acted with malicious intent.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 በዩታ ቫሊ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ስለተገደለው አክቲቪስት ቻርሊ ኪርክ የተደረገ ገለልተኛ ጥናት በዝግጅቱ አደረጃጀት ውስጥ ትልቅ የደህንነት ጉድለቶች እንደነበሩ አጋልጧል። ዩኒቨርሲቲው ተገቢውን የአደጋ ግምገማ ሳያደርግ ለዝግጅቱ አዘጋጆች ማለትም 'ተርኒንግ ፖይንት ዩኤስኤ' ለደህንነት ስጋቶች ቦታ እንዲሰጡ መፍቀዱ ተመልክቷል። የምርመራው ውጤት በዩኒቨርሲቲው ፖሊስ እና በግል የደህንነት ጠባቂዎች መካከል የተቀናጀ ስራ እንዳልነበረ ቢጠቁምም፣ የዩኒቨርሲቲው ሰራተኞች ሆን ብለው ጉዳት ለማድረስ አላሰቡም ብሏል።
oromo: Qorannoon bilisaa ajjeechaa aktivistii Chaarlie Kirk kan bara 2025 yuunivarsitii Yuuta Vaalii keessatti raawwatame irratti gaggeeffame, qophii sagantichaa keessatti hanqina nageenyaa gurguddaa akka ture ifa godheera. Gabaasichi yuunivarsitiin kun madaallii nageenyaa sirrii ta'e osoo hin gaggeessin, gurmuu saganticha qopheesseef iddoo alaatiif durii qaban akka hordofan heeyyama kennuusaanii ibseera. Qorattoonni poolisii yuunivarsitichaa fi eegdota dhuunfaa gidduutti walitti hidhamiinsi gaariin akka hin turre kan eeran yoo ta'u, hojjettoonni yuunivarsitichaa yaada hamaadhaan tarkaanfii fudhataniiru jedhee hin amanu.

title: Venezuelan government, opposition agree to work towards reform of top court
english: Venezuela’s interim government and opposition leaders have agreed to form a special committee to reform the country's Supreme Court. This collaborative panel will review the process for selecting judges as part of broader efforts to change the judicial system. While these talks mark a step toward political dialogue, critics note that major democratic reforms and election timelines remain uncertain under the current administration.
amharic: የቬኔዝዌላ ጊዜያዊ መንግስት እና የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎች የሀገሪቱን ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ለማሻሻል የሚያስችል ልዩ ኮሚቴ ለማቋቋም ተስማምተዋል። ይህ የጋራ ኮሚቴ የዳኞችን የመምረጫ ሂደት በመገምገም የፍትህ ስርዓቱን ለማሻሻል ይሰራል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ስምምነት ለፖለቲካዊ ውይይት አንድ እርምጃ ቢሆንም፣ አሁን ያለው አስተዳደር ሰፊ ዲሞክራሲያዊ ለውጦችን እና የምርጫ ጊዜ ሰሌዳን በተመለከተ ግልጽ የሆነ መረጃ አለመስጠቱ ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan ce'umsaa fi hogganoonni mormituu Venezuela mana murtii olaanaa biyyattii fooyyessuuf koree addaa dhaabuuf walii galan. Koreen kun adeemsa filannoo abbootii seeratii fi sirna haqaa fooyyessuuf kan hojjetu ta'a. Mareen kun tarkaanfii gara marii siyaasaatti fudhatame ta'us, bulchiinsi ammaa kun jijjiirama cimaa fi yeroo filannoo ilaalchisee waadaa ifa ta'e akka hin galle komatamaa jira.

title: Women take up arms as sexual violence ravages eastern DRC
english: In the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, women are joining the pro-government Wazalendo militia to protect their families from ongoing conflict and sexual violence. Despite this shift, the militia is also being investigated for its own history of severe human rights violations. These women now find themselves in a precarious position as they fight alongside a group accused of perpetrating the very abuses they seek to escape.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል፣ ሴቶች ከጦርነት እና ከጾታዊ ጥቃት እራሳቸውን ለመከላከል ሲሉ ዋዛሌንዶ በተሰኘው የመንግስት ደጋፊ ታጣቂ ቡድን ውስጥ እየተቀላቀሉ ይገኛሉ። ሆኖም ይህ ታጣቂ ቡድን በራሱ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን በመፈጸም እና በቡድን አስገድዶ መድፈር ወንጀል ተከሷል። እነዚህ ሴቶች ከጥቃት ለመከላከል በሚያደርጉት ጥረት፣ በተመሳሳይ የጥቃት ወንጀል በሚከሰሱ ቡድኖች ውስጥ መሳተፋቸው ከፍተኛ ስጋትን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Baha Rippabiliika Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti, dubartoonni waraanaa fi haleellaa saalaa irraa of ittisuuf jechuun garee waraanaa mootummaa deggeru kan 'Wazalendo' jedhamutti makamaa jiru. Ta'us, gareen kun namoota irratti miidhaa gurguddaa fi ajjeechaa akkasumas dirqisiisuun wal qunnamtii saalaa raawwachuu dhaan himatameera. Dubartoonni kun miidhaa irraa of baraaruuf garee waraanaa kana keessatti hirmaatanis, gareen sun ofii isaatiin yakka raawwachuun shakkamuun haala ulfaataa keessa isaan galcheera.

title: At least 10 people killed in Russian and Ukrainian attacks
english: Recent cross-border attacks between Russia and Ukraine have resulted in the deaths of at least ten people. Russian strikes targeted various Ukrainian cities, including Zaporizhzhia and Sumy, while Ukrainian drone operations hit industrial sites and an oil refinery within Russian territory. Meanwhile, diplomatic tensions remain high as Moscow blames European nations for obstructing potential peace negotiations.
amharic: በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል በተደረጉ የድንበር ተሻጋሪ ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ አስር ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የሩሲያ ጥቃቶች እንደ ዛፖሪዝሂያ እና ሱሚ ባሉ የዩክሬን ከተሞች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ሲሆን የዩክሬን ድሮኖች ደግሞ በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚገኙ የኢንዱስትሪ ማዕከላትና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያን መትተዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሞስኮ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት የሰላም ድርድሮችን እያደናቀፉ ነው በማለት ስትወቅስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውጥረቱ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa fi Yukreen gidduutti haleellaa wal irraa fudhatameen namoonni hanga kudhan ta'an du'aniiru. Haleellaan Ruusiyaa magaalota Yukreen akka Zaapoorizhiyaa fi Sumiitti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, Yukreenis karaa doroonii biyya Ruusiyaa keessatti bakkeewwan indaastirii fi bo'ii boba'aa rukuteetti. Gama biraan, Ruusiyaan biyyoonni Awurooppaa marii nagaa akka hin milkoofne gufuu ta'aa jiru jechuun himatteetti.

title: Jerusalem Daily: violence continues as the world watches the UNGA
english: As the United Nations General Assembly continues its sessions, world leaders are actively condemning ongoing Israeli military actions against Palestinians. Despite this international pressure, Israeli forces and settlers have maintained their strikes across the West Bank and Gaza. The situation remains tense as the global community watches these developments unfold.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ በሂደት ላይ እያለ፣ የዓለም መሪዎች በእስራኤል በኩል በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ጥቃት እያወገዙ ነው። ይህ ዓለም አቀፍ ጫና ቢኖርም፣ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በጋዛ እና በዌስት ባንክ ጥቃታቸውን አሁንም እንደቀጠሉበት ነው። ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ሁኔታውን በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Walgahii waliigala gamtaa mootummootaa adeemsifamaa jiruun walqabatee, hogganoonni addunyaa tarkaanfii waraana Israa'el Falasxiinota irratti fudhatamaa jiru cimsanii balaaleffachaa jiru. Dhiibbaan addunyaa kun jiraatus, waraanni Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoonni isaanii lafa Gaazaa fi West Baankii keessatti haleellaa raawwachuun itti fufaniiru. Haalli kun sadarkaa addunyaatti xiyyeeffannoo argatee hordofamaa jira.
